title: A general-purpose System One decision model for clinical records
abstract: arXiv:2610.27099v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical care, health-system operations and biomedical discovery depend on extracting reliable answers from patient records, yet applying diverse clinical questions across entire populations remains computationally expensive. Here we present Clinical System One (CS1), a 4-billion-parameter decision model for fast, typed judgments from clinical records, along with two agentic harnesses in which CS1 works together with a generalist language model. CS1-4B is trained on 12.4 million questions and answers from 3.6 million patients across a multi-hospital health system, combining structured-data keys, observed outcomes and language-model supervision across clinical notes, diagnostic reports and patient timelines. It answers multiple typed questions in a single forward pass without task-specific retraining, and each answer carries a probability that can route uncertain cases to human review. On 963,408 held-out patients, CS1-4B outperformed ope

translated_title: 一种面向临床记录的通用“系统一”决策模型
translated_abstract: 临床护理、医疗系统运营和生物医学发现都依赖于从患者病历中提取可靠的答案，然而在整个人群中应用多样化的临床问题在计算上仍然十分昂贵。在此，我们提出了Clinical System One（CS1），一个40亿参数的决策模型，能够从临床记录中进行快速、类型化的判断，并配有两种智能体框架，使CS1与通用语言模型协同工作。CS1-4B基于某多医院医疗系统中360万名患者的1240万问答对进行训练，融合了结构化数据键、观测结果以及覆盖临床笔记、诊断报告和患者时间线的语言模型监督。它可以在单次前向传播中回答多种类型的问题，无需针对具体任务进行再训练，且每个答案都附带概率，可将不确定的病例转交人工审查。在963,408名留出患者上，CS1-4B的表现优于……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了40亿参数的决策模型Clinical System One（CS1），基于360万名患者的1240万问答数据训练，无需任务特定再训练即可在单次前向传播中对临床记录进行快速、类型化的判断，并通过答案概率将不确定病例路由至人工审查，与通用语言模型协同构成智能体框架。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Clinical System One (CS1), a 4-billion-parameter decision model trained on 12.4 million Q&As from 3.6 million patients, which delivers fast, typed judgments on clinical records in a single forward pass without task-specific retraining, using answer probabilities to route uncertain cases to human review and working with a generalist language model in agentic harnesses.
